title: Low-cost biomimetic sensor based on copper porphyrin-modified graphite electrodes for electrochemical detection of glyphosate in aqueous samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30482-30489
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05306D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ana M. Janeiro Tudanca, Rolando M. Caraballo, Facundo C. Herrera, Paula Giudici, Mariana Hamer
We present a biomimetic electrochemical sensor for glyphosate (GLY) detection, utilizing graphite electrodes modified with electropolymerized copper(II) meso-tetra(4-sulfonatophenyl)porphyrin (CuP).
